tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// snyan rgyud las yum ka lhan cig skyes ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

༄༅// gang sku li khri'i snang ba brgya'i thig les// skal bzang sgo gsum nyin mor byin rlob pa'i// rnam 'gyur pha mtha' med pa'i 'od tshogs can// rtag brtan nam mkha'i mdzes rgyan ma der 'dud// grub dbang rnams kyi bdud rtsis rab myos nas// legs bshad skyugs pas phyogs dus kun bkang phyir// sba gsang med pa'i smyon pa 'ga' zhig tu// rtog par gyur kyang bdag la bya thabs ci// 'dir snyan rgyud lhan cig skyes ma'i rnal 'byor du bya ba bshad par bya ste/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ gtor ma dang mchod pas mdun bdar/ cang te'u dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin cing dam tshig gi ril bus kha dag par byas te/ rang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar dmigs te/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las bsgral te byang chub chen po la 'god pa'i bsam pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub pa'i// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro ba sngar btang nas sems bskyed blang*/ de nas/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma dang thugs rgyud gcig kyang*/ rnam pa'i rol mo rdo rje 'chang la thug gi bar gyi bla ma dpal he ru ka dpa' bo dpa' mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba thams cad gcer bu phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sku gar stabs ling nge*/ gsung rdo rje'i glu rtse re/ thugs bdag la byin gyis rlob pa'i bzhed pa rtse gcig pa nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi phung po lta bur bzhugs pa la/ dad pa rgya mtshos bdag gi lus longs spyod// zhing khams rgya mtsho ma lus khyab pa'i sprin// mchod pa rgya mtshor dmigs nas 'bul lags kyi// thugs rje rgya mtshos dgongs nas bzhes su gsol// zhes mchod de/ rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor ma// de sras til+li nā ro dang*// lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan mar mi la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// ras chung zhabs dang khyung tshang pa// ma gcig ong jo lo chen zhang*// dha ra shrī bsod nams mtshan// gsol ba=

kun ldan ras ma bde legs dpal// kun dga'i dpal dang rgyal ba'i dbang*// ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po la/ gsol ba= rdo rje sems dngos pad dkar zhabs// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab lha rtse ba// rje btsun dpag bsam dbang po la// gsol ba= 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bud+dha'i mtshan// ma lus 'gro ba'i yongs 'dzin rje// mchog gzigs yar 'phel dbang po la// gsol ba= khyab bdag thugs kyi rdo rje dang*// he ru ka dpal bde chen sku// rdo rje nyi ma drin can rjer// gsol ba= kun mkhyen chos kyi snang ba che// snying po'i bstan 'dzin ye shes grub// nges don chos kyi rgya mtsho la// gsol ba= shes bya kun gzigs mkhyen pa'i gter// grub brnyes bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog /mthu chen chos kyi rgya mtsho la// gsol ba= 'dren mchog 'jam dpal nor bu'i zhabs// chos dbyings bde chen rdo rje rtsal// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong yang*// gang gi rol rtsed yin shes nas// rje btsun bla ma khyed min pa'i// skyabs gzhan bdag cag rnams mi tshol// de phyir nyam nga'i 'khor ba las// 'gro ba 'dren pa'i thugs rje'i mthu// bskul ba'i gsol ba 'debs lags na// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// smin byed dbang gis rgyud bsros nas// grol lam gser 'gyur rtsis bran pas// mi gtsang lus 'di rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen mchog tu gyur cig gu/ zhes gsol ba btab/ mos gus kyi gdung bas 'od du zhu nas bdag la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur gcig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig snying gar bsil zer can gyi dbus su baṃ/

mtha' mar oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes pa'i yig 'phreng li khri'i khu bas bris pa lta bus bskor ba las 'od zer 'ja' tshon sna lnga pa'i skud pa gshibs pa lta bur thams cad du 'phro bas rang lus rnam par sbyangs pas/ skad cig gis yid tsam khro ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba gcer mo spyan gsum mnga' ba skra grol ba phyag rgya lnga'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan g.yas brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis mnan pa/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs khar dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dkar po mchan du bcug ste sgeg cing 'gying ba dang bcas pa bcu drug pa'i lang tsho ngom pa/ 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi lha mo dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad sbyangs pas snod gzhal yas khang*/ pho thams cad he ru ka mo thams cad rnal 'byor mar gyur te slar log rang gi snying gar thim par bsam mo/ de sna rtser thig le dkar dmar kha sbyar ba la dmigs te rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya/ de nas phreng ba dam pa rigs brgyar bsams nas sngags re la de'i lha re bdag la thim par mos la gong gi snying po de brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de nas 'od kyis snod/ bcud la/ de rang la/ rang yas mas nas zhu snying ga'i sngags/ de baṃ/ de zla tshes/ thig le nā da'i bar du bsdus nas/ de yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid la gzhug par gyur/ yang skyo na sngar bzhin chu las nya ldang ba lta bur langs te bsgom pa dang bzla bar bya/ de las skyo na/ gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ raṃ kaṃ las rlung dang me dang mgo sgyed kyi steng du/ a las thod pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i kha zla phyed rdo rjes chod pa/

snying ga'i bam̐ gyi 'od kyis rlung bskul bas me 'bar te thod pa'i rdzas rnams zhu/ zla phyed rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis 'og min nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug pa de la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas ngag tu pheṃ zhes brjod/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis bcom ldan 'das ma la 'khor 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛṣ+ya hoḥ kha kha khā hi a li u li i daṃ ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis phul bas ljags rdo rje dkar po rtse mo gcig pa sbu gu can gyis gsol bar bsams te/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pas chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtog pa bcom// khyod ni dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan// mgon po thugs rje'i chu yi brjid kyis brlan par gyur pa'i thugs kyi chus// bdag la mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol// ces 'dod don gsol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod de badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod nas gtor mgron gshegs/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog/ ces bsngo ba bya'o// yum lhan cig skyes ma'i sgrub thabs pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba rdzogs so/// /
